name: European Single Access Point (ESAP)
evidence_rating: ex-ante only: ESAP starts operating in July 2027
summary: ESMA must open the single access point by 10 July 2027, so there is no evidence on use yet. The impact assessment put ESMA's set-up and running costs at up to EUR 16 million over 2022-2027 and companies' recurring filing costs at around EUR 121 million a year EU-wide; benefits for investors were described but not quantified.

indicators.objective: ESAP to be established by 10 July 2027

indicators.indicator: Costs of ESAP and of filing
indicators.target_or_baseline: ESMA up to EUR 16 million (2022-2027); filers about EUR 121 million a year (forecast)

literature.citation: European Commission (2021), Impact Assessment accompanying the proposals establishing a European single access point (executive summary), SWD(2021) 345 (full IA SWD(2021) 344)
literature.title: Impact Assessment accompanying the proposals establishing a European single access point (executive summary)
literature.headline: ESMA's costs up to EUR 16 million in 2022-2027; one-off interconnection about EUR 50,800 per collection body; recurring filing costs up to EUR 800 per entity, about EUR 121 million a year EU-wide
literature.summary_plain: The Commission expected a central portal for company disclosures to help investors, at modest cost per company.
